facts.raw_span: progressive bilateral nasal airway obstruction
voluminous, pulsatile, highly vascularized mass in both nasal cavities
hypervascular and pulsatile tumor occupies almost the entire right nasal fossa
Enhanced CT scan showed a hypervascular tumor in the nasal cavity, on the left thyroid, the fifth rib, and the L4 vertebra
Confirmed a hypervascular tumor with anterior skull base extension
considerable uptake regarding rib and vertebral lesions
sinonasal tumor had low uptake, indicative of thyroid tissue with low iodine avidity
Serum Thyroglobulin: 4432 ng/mL (significantly elevated)
Costal Biopsy: Pointed to VTC metastasis
Sinonasal Tumor Biopsy: Confirmed VTC metastasis

The patient's biopsies and elevated serum thyroglobulin level are consistent with papillary thyroid carcinoma.

The patient's endoscopic examination and imaging studies revealed a hypervascular nasal tumor.
The patient's biopsies and imaging studies revealed metastasis to the nasal cavity.

rationales.F02: The presence of a voluminous, pulsatile, highly vascularized mass in both nasal cavities suggests a strong rule-in for C05 (Hypervascular Nasal Tumor) and moderate rule-in for C01 (Vascular Thyroid Cancer metastasis) and C06 (Nasal Cavity Metastasis).
rationales.F04: The enhanced CT scan showing a hypervascular tumor in the nasal cavity, on the left thyroid, the fifth rib, and the L4 vertebra strongly suggests a rule-in for C01 (Vascular Thyroid Cancer metastasis), C05 (Hypervascular Nasal Tumor), and C06 (Nasal Cavity Metastasis).
rationales.F08: The significantly elevated serum thyroglobulin level strongly suggests a rule-in for C01 (Vascular Thyroid Cancer metastasis), C02 (Papillary Thyroid Carcinoma), C03 (Follicular Thyroid Carcinoma), C04 (Medullary Thyroid Carcinoma), and C06 (Nasal Cavity Metastasis).
rationales.F09: The costal biopsy pointing to VTC metastasis strongly suggests a rule-in for C01 (Vascular Thyroid Cancer metastasis) and C06 (Nasal Cavity Metastasis).
rationales.F10: The sinonasal tumor biopsy confirming VTC metastasis strongly suggests a rule-in for C01 (Vascular Thyroid Cancer metastasis) and C06 (Nasal Cavity Metastasis).
